propositions: Rebar-janitor artifacts from 2026-08-16 session were lost and must be reconstructed from local transcript without modifying production code.

The historical repository convention stores janitor artifacts locally in `.joe-janitor/` not `.rebar-janitor/`, and the recovered report must preserve this convention with an explicit RECOVERED banner.

Recovered decisions RP-01 through RP-06 must each document evidence record, rationale, approval status, and recovery confidence with source attribution to transcript/repository/tracker/external research.
The recovered report must map janitor protocol phases and explicitly name unrecoverable outputs; Phase 5 cleanup outputs were never reached and none were created.
Six decisions were all approved (RP-02 as proposed; RP-01/RP-03/RP-04/RP-05/RP-06 with refinements); decisions RP-07–RP-28 were never presented and are not recovered.

The recovered artifact at `.joe-janitor/report-2026-08-16-recovered.md` (671 lines, SHA-256 c8a382504f15c591505df56fd55d3c5a84313f3eb57c9c4dd71153c350426cd6) remains intentionally git-excluded with no production-code changes.
